punchline: Gordievsky did not wake up one day and betray; he saw a wall and tanks.
thirty_sec: Posted to East Berlin in 1961, joining the KGB in 1963 and serving in Copenhagen in 1966, Gordievsky by his own account lost lasting trust in his system after the Wall and the 1968 invasion of Czechoslovakia; MI6 began working with him in the years that followed.
question: Which single event changed your view on some matter for good?
key_contrast: The turn came from a scene, not an argument.
